card.name: Split-off "r" starting words like rained
card.fires_on: The lone letter "r" when it begins a word that was split into pieces, such as r|arer, r|angelands, r|ained, r|ashes, r|aged. The next piece is a vowel-led ending like "ar", "ain" or "ash".

modes.label: r before other endings
modes.description: The "r" starts a noun or adjective such as rarer, rangelands, rashes or rind.
modes.example: Workers regularly complain of nausea, dizziness, skin<< r>>ashes and headaches.

card.writes: It favors odd, split-up text pieces and suppresses Chinese characters, so it adds little meaningful output.
